name: expense-api

dependencies.name: payroll-service
dependencies.description: Receives the batch of approved claims finance exports for payment.

description: Owns expense claims end to end: creation, listing, editing and withdrawal by the submitting employee; team-scoped review, approval and rejection by the employee's manager; and the finance-facing batch export to payroll. Sends the decision email when a manager approves or rejects a claim. Does not implement the category-suggestion logic (category-agent) or the payroll system itself.
